features: Signature Sennheiser Sound – Enjoy detailed stereo sound with balanced bass and crisp treble for a superior audio experience
In-Line Microphone & Smart Remote – Easily manage calls and music playback with the built-in mic and single-button remote

Inline remote and microphone for easy call and music control
Lightweight in-ear design with three ear tip sizes (size M on the product) for a secure fit that provides passive noise isolation
Durable materials for reliable everyday listening
USB C connection delivers stable, uncompressed audio without pairing or charging
